description: This file defines the EmployeeImmigrationRecord class representing immigration record data related to an employee, including passport and visa details, and methods for accessing and manipulating this data. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping and includes constants for document types.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationRecord
classes.description: Represents an immigration record for an employee, including passport or visa details, with database ORM mappings and related accessor methods.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this immigration record.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with this immigration record.

methods.name: getRecordId
methods.description: Returns the record ID of the immigration record.

methods.name: setRecordId
methods.description: Sets the record ID of the immigration record.

methods.name: getNumber
methods.description: Returns the passport or visa number.

methods.name: setNumber
methods.description: Sets the passport or visa number.

methods.name: getIssuedDate
methods.description: Returns the date the passport or visa was issued.

methods.name: setIssuedDate
methods.description: Sets the date the passport or visa was issued.

methods.name: getExpiryDate
methods.description: Returns the expiry date of the passport or visa.

methods.name: setExpiryDate
methods.description: Sets the expiry date of the passport or visa.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns comments related to this immigration record.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets comments related to this immigration record.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of document (passport or visa).

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the type of document.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the I-9 status.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the I-9 status.

methods.name: getReviewDate
methods.description: Returns the review date of the I-9 form.

methods.name: setReviewDate
methods.description: Sets the review date of the I-9 form.

methods.name: getCountryCode
methods.description: Returns the country code related to the record.

methods.name: setCountryCode
methods.description: Sets the country code related to the record.
